money._not_the_launcher_log_figure: the launcher printed '6.2 min, $0.11' and that is GPU ONLY. The provider bills the provisioned container disk for the pod's whole lifetime and the runner never sees it, so all-in is the GPU actual plus disk derived from the authorization's own disk rate times elapsed minutes. Publishing the log figure understated this attempt by $0.0046 and the next attempt's reconciliation gate refused the launch at $0 over exactly that.

what_happened:
The volume repair worked: with no datacenter pin the draw found an L40S within five minutes, where attempt8 had been refused eight times over 35 minutes in EU-NL-1. Pod 4yumqr65qp5c00 came up at $1.09/h and SSH answered in 0.5 min.

Setup then failed at its CPU test gate. 27 cases in tests/c2_behavioural_preflight failed on the pod and one skipped that the launch-bound sweep had not skipped, so the gate refused twice over -- on the failures and on the skip-set divergence. No science ran. The pod was deleted 6.2 minutes in and the provider confirmed it gone.
root_cause:
tests/c2_behavioural_preflight is the ONE test directory a behavioural pod does not ignore, and 27 of its cases read the out-of-tree durable store -- the five reconstructed replay products and the campaign's completed probes. A session stages an asset's BYTES and never the store they were frozen in, so no pod has it: `candidate_manifest` raised BehaviouralProposalError, and `trainable_parameter_count` reached it through `_reference_checkpoint` on the branch taken when no `checkpoint=` is passed, which every test overrides and only a pod exercises.

The launch-bound sweep could not see any of this because the store was reached by a HARDCODED ABSOLUTE PATH. The simulator isolates by pointing HOME at a fresh empty directory, and an absolute path is immune to that, so the sweep certified a machine the pod could not reproduce. `aadistill.runtime.cpu_test_env.host_local_store` exists for exactly this reason and says so in its docstring -- 'a hardcoded absolute path is immune to the fresh empty HOME, which is what let host-local cases run in the diagnostic and skip on the pod' -- and the two behavioural DURABLE_STORE constants were not using it. The same blind spot is recorded in `record_pod_environment.host_local_stores` as having cost C1 attempt 14 $0.40 and 22 minutes; that mechanism derives host-local stores from a launcher's DOCUMENTS, and these stores live in code, so it never saw them.
repair: Both behavioural DURABLE_STORE constants now derive through `host_local_store()`, so they resolve identically on this dev box and vanish under the simulator's empty HOME exactly as they are absent on a pod. A shared `tests/c2_behavioural_preflight/conftest.py` adds `host_local_stores_are_absent()`, keyed on THE CONDITION and never on a simulator marker -- a pod is behaviourally identical to a machine that never had the store while carrying none of the simulator's markers, so 'am I in the simulation?' is inverted precisely where it matters. The 27 cases carry that skipif.
regression: Dev box with the store present: 236 passed, 0 skipped -- full coverage retained. Pod-like with the store hidden by `unshare -r -m` + tmpfs: 208 passed, 28 skipped, 0 failed, which is exactly the 27 failures plus the one pre-existing skip and nothing more. Two methods inside the marked classes were found to pass without the store and had their marks narrowed away rather than being allowed to skip on the pod, because a skip on the pod certifies nothing about the pod. `audit_skip_predicates` resolves all of them `normalized_by_contract` -- its own classification for a premise located through $HOME -- with verdict PASS, parity PASS, 0 stale, 0 unaccounted. Targeted regression across the CPU-test contract, the behavioural proposal and schedule, and the whole preflight scope: 297 passed.
why_a_fresh_chain: the repair touches the launcher and behavioural.py, both in the executable closure, so the closure moved and attempt9's authorization and bundle no longer bind this tree.
consumed: $0.11 all-in for 6.2 minutes of L40S. One provider resource, created and provider-confirmed deleted. No training, no scoring, no measurement -- the abort is before any formal science, so nothing scientific was retried or pooled.
gate_that_refused: the pod's own setup test gate (TESTS_OK), not a pre-provider gate
what_the_sweep_should_have_caught: everything. The sweep is the mechanism whose entire purpose is to describe the tree a pod will receive, and it passed 236/236 on a machine state no pod has. A $0 reproduction of the pod's filesystem -- `unshare -r -m` plus a tmpfs over the store -- now exists and is what verified the repair.
